name: Can I prevent water hammer from happening in my home?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent water hammer from happening in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing water hammer often involves proactive measures. Ensuring your water pressure is within recommended limits (typically 40-80 psi) by using a pressure regulator can significantly reduce occurrences. Additionally, having water hammer arrestors installed during new construction or appliance installations can prevent the issue. If you notice early signs of banging, addressing them promptly can prevent the problem from worsening. Regular plumbing inspections can also help identify potential issues before they become severe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent water hammer by maintaining proper water pressure, installing arrestors during construction, and addressing early signs promptly.
